historical_coverage: aggregates repositories worldwide; strongest for EU-funded output from the 2000s
known_limitations: as an aggregator it re-publishes the same paper from many repositories: DOI de-duplication is mandatory before counting
the graph record id is an internal dedup hash, not an authoritative external id
dateOfAcceptance is repository acceptance, not publication
licence: OpenAIRE Graph metadata is CC-BY 4.0; aggregated repository records keep their own rights
rate_limits: not published as a hard number; fair-use (we paced at 1 req/s)
research_value: Best coverage of EU-funded and repository-hosted output (Horizon projects), which is where European device manufacturers publish; useful complement to OpenAlex for non-US literature.
